-- Module:Data/Sources
-- Where an item comes from, typed in by editors: what the game data does not know (drops, vendors, events ...).
-- It is shown under "Other" in the "Obtained from" part of the item card (hover card of {{Item}}, {{Tooltip}}, {{Consumable}}).
-- The crafts and quests are filled in by sync_wiki_data.py, they do not go here.
--
-- One entry per item ID, with one line of text per row of the list. The text may use wiki links and bold:
--   [28189] = {
--     "Dropped by bosses in Greater Dungeons.",
--     "Sold by [[Dungeon Vendor]] for 1 Dungeon Medal.",
--   },
-- A single line can be written without the braces:   [9000341] = "Dropped by Berserker monsters.",
-- To add a line only for one place on a page, use source= on the template instead: {{Item|ItemID=28189|source=Line one;;Line two}}
-- This page is never changed by the sync script.
return {
	-- Brimstone Wisps: all made the same way (the Brimstone Orb turns obsidian gear into a wisp)
